subject: PoC decision checklist: deployment mode tradeoffs and next steps (NimbleHealth)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Lee <erin.lee@nimblehealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: PoC decision checklist: deployment mode tradeoffs and next steps (NimbleHealth)

Hi Erin / team — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed path forward so we can lock the PoC modality that best meets NimbleHealth requirements. High level takeaways from our call:

- Primary constraints you called out: PHI/data isolation (non-negotiable), predictable 100 QPS inference bursts during business hours, and sub-150ms 95th percentile latency on common prompts.
- Desired outcome of PoC: validate accuracy on your test prompts, prove latency at 100 QPS, and complete a security checklist for legal/procurement sign-off.

Options we discussed (short):
- Hosted API: fastest to start (sandbox in 24h), lowest up-front ops, but data flows through Redwood hosted endpoints — suitable if you accept token-redaction safeguards and can route PHI via pseudo-data.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool, predictable throughput, tenant isolation at infra level, SLA-backed. Good for production-like perf testing without on-prem ops.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): maximum data isolation (customer-managed network or air-gapped on-prem), required for PHI in many regulated customers; longer lead time and project coordination with infra/security.

Proposed PoC structure (4-week plan):
1) Week 0 (pre-work): exchange security contact, sample test prompts & schema, and non-PHI sample data. I attached the PoC template to collect these.
2) Week 1 (functional): run core prompts, validate output quality & prompt engineering; Hosted sandbox recommended to iterate quickly.
3) Week 2 (performance): run throughput tests at target QPS and measure p95 latencies; use Dedicated infra if you want production-like numbers.
4) Week 3 (security/compliance): run our security checklist and evidence collection (SOC 2 excerpts, network diagrams). Private deployment conversations happen in parallel if required.
5) Week 4 (pilot & wrap): pilot a small production workload or finalize Private deployment on-boarding.

Decision asks for NimbleHealth by EOD next Tue (2026-12-07):
- Which deployment mode do you want us to prioritize for the PoC kickoff (Hosted sandbox -> Dedicated -> Private)?
- Who is your security/compliance lead for evidence exchange?
- Please confirm procurement contact and any contract constraints (e.g., vendor questionnaire, PO terms).

I attached: nimble-poc-template.xlsx and redwood-poc-checklist.pdf. If PHI is a hard requirement for the PoC, we should plan Private or Dedicated with clear isolation — we can run a hybrid: start Hosted for functional & then pivot to Dedicated/Private for perf/security tests.

Happy to host a 30-minute checklist call with our security/infra engineers — suggested slots: Tue/Wed next week 10–12 PT.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
(jordan.blake@redwood.ai)

---
(Attachment stubs: nimble-poc-template.xlsx (Excel, 45KB), redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (PDF, 210KB))

From: Erin Lee <erin.lee@nimblehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimblehealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PoC decision checklist: deployment mode tradeoffs and next steps (NimbleHealth)

Jordan — thanks for the clear plan and the templates. A few clarifications from our side so we can pick the right path: 

1) Data sensitivity: Our clinical transcripts contain PHI. For any testing beyond synthetic examples, we must ensure either Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) or a Dedicated environment with strict contractual terms and encryption-at-rest + customer-managed keys.
2) Latency: 150ms p95 is our target, but we care more about consistent p95 during peak windows. If Dedicated is required to hit that SLA, note we might want a short perf-only Dedicated trial.
3) Timeline: We can be ready to hand over non-PHI sample prompts within 48 hours. For PHI test runs we need a security kickoff before any real data exchange.

Procurement is included on this thread — they will need SOW and insurance limits for review. Please loop in a legal/compliance contact from Redwood who can discuss KMS/HSM options and data residency.

Erin Lee
Head of Product | NimbleHealth
(erin.lee@nimblehealth.com)

(Attachment: nimble-sample-schema.json — redacted)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Lee <erin.lee@nimblehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PoC decision checklist: deployment mode tradeoffs and next steps (NimbleHealth)

Thanks Erin — understood and appreciate the constraints. Proposed immediate actions: 

- Security kickoff: Priya, can you lead a 45-minute security call this week to cover KMS/HSM, evidence list, and private deployment feasibility? Erin, please share your security owner's contact (or I can put you in touch with Priya).
- PoC approach recommendation: start functional iteration on Hosted sandbox (no PHI), then run perf pass on Dedicated (short reserved window) to validate p95 at 100 QPS. If the security kickoff requires stricter controls, we will spin up Private/VPC in parallel; we’ll estimate timeline during the call.
- Procurement asks: draft SOW and insurance limits — Stephanie, can you prepare a one-page SOW + cost estimate for a 4-week hybrid PoC (Hosted func + Dedicated perf) and a separate Private deployment estimate? Link to a draft SOW in the related links.

Erin — if you sign off on the hybrid path, we’ll target a functional sandbox start as early as next Monday (2026-12-07) and perf tests the week after. Please confirm.

Jordan

Date: 2026-12-01T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PoC decision checklist: deployment mode tradeoffs and next steps (NimbleHealth)

Jordan / Stephanie — copying my notes and resource asks for planning the Private/Dedicated paths: 

- Private (on-prem or VPC) checklist: network diagram, firewall rules, VPN/Direct Connect details, IAM requirements, and whether customer requires air-gapped image install. If on-prem is selected, we'll need a 2-week lead for packaging + validation.
- Dedicated: estimate for 2 x A100-class instances (or equivalent) for perf testing at 100 QPS depending on prompt length; we should confirm expected sequence lengths — Erin, can you confirm average and 95th percentile token lengths for your prompts?
- Evidence & artifacts we can provide immediately: SOC 2 Type II summary, encryption-at-rest docs, standard pen-test report. For KMS/HSM we can support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration; we will document the flow for the security call.

I attached the initial deployment playbook (poc-deploy-plan.md) and will prepare a short checklist to capture the network details from Nimble.

Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(priya_natarajan@redwood.ai)
